# gitmoap_repository_branch (Data Source)

Get a branch by name. The branch's tip commit, how far it is ahead of and behind the default branch, whether a rule protects it, whether you may push to it and why not, and the open merge requests that propose it. Anyone who can read the repository's code may call it.

The token needs `branch:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_name` (String) Branch name
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `ahead` (Number)
- `behind` (Number)
- `commit` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--commit))
- `open_merge_requests` (Attributes List) The open merge requests proposing this branch — one per target branch at most. A commit to
the branch updates each of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--open_merge_requests))
- `protected` (Boolean) A branch rule protects this branch.
- `push_refusal` (String) Why the caller may not push here, in a sentence to show them. Absent when they may.
- `repository_id` (String)
- `viewer_can_push` (Boolean) Whether the caller may push to this branch — the same verdict a `git push` or a commit
written in the browser gets. `false` for someone not signed in.
